lines.en: label tsukasaspring7:
scene noonsky
: Chinami! Have you seen my keys anywhere?
lines.zh: : Chinami!有没有看到我的钥匙?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know where your keys are! But she thinks it’s very possible you may have traded them for another poster of Niki based on recent character trajectory!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道你钥匙在哪!但她觉得,按照你最近的人设轨迹,你很可能拿它们去换了一张新的 Niki 海报!

lines.en: : Well, Chinami is wrong! Because, while big sis Chika may love Niki, she will always love you more! Oh. Here they are.
lines.zh: : 嗯,Chinami 错了!因为,虽然 Chika 大姐爱 Niki,她永远更爱你!哦。在这里。

lines.en: : If big sis Chika loves Chinami so much, how come there are no posters of Chinami in the house?!
lines.zh: : 要是 Chika 大姐那么爱 Chinami,那为什么家里一张 Chinami 的海报都没有?!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss1

: Because Chinami isn’t an idol yet. Nor is she allowed to be because big sis Chika has seen the exploitation junior idols face and doesn’t want swimsuit videos of Chinami being peddled to creepy old guys.
lines.zh: : 因为 Chinami 还不是偶像。而且也不许当——因为 Chika 大姐见过未成年偶像面对的剥削,不想让 Chinami 的泳装视频被推销给猥琐老头。

lines.en: : But you’re dating a creepy old guy.
lines.zh: : 可你在和一个猥琐老头约会。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss2
: And when you girls are in high school, you’ll be allowed to date creepy old guys too. But until then, you must remain pure and good and nothing like the monster I have become.
lines.zh: : 等你们上了高中,你们也会被允许约会猥琐老头的。但在那之前,你们必须保持纯洁、善良,一点也不要像我变成的这个怪物。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss3
: Do you need anything before I go to work? No ordering food. There are leftovers in the fridge.
lines.zh: : 我上班前你还需要什么吗?不许点外卖。冰箱里有剩菜。

lines.en: : Can you tell Chinami the Netflix password? She tried logging in to watch Breaking Bad again but it’s not “ShiningStar03!” anymore.
lines.zh: : 能告诉 Chinami 网飞的密码吗?她想登录重温《绝命毒师》,但密码已经不是「ShiningStar03」了!

lines.en: : That’s because I cancelled our Netflix account.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我把我们的网飞账号取消了。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss4
: YOU DID WHAT?!
lines.zh: : 你干了什么?!

lines.en: : Well, yeah. They keep raising the prices. And I spent, like, all of my savings during a delusional shopping spree the last time we went to the mall. Gotta cut costs where I can, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对。他们一直涨价。而且上次去商场,我在一场狂乱的购物狂欢里花光了差不多全部积蓄。能省则省,Chinami。

lines.en: : THEN STOP COMING HOME WITH BOBA TEA AND GIVE CHINAMI HER NETFLIX BACK!
lines.zh: : 那就别再端着奶茶回家,把网飞还给 CHINAMI!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss5
: I get those drinks from work, Chinami. And I bring you some too, so don’t make it sound like that is being financially irresponsible.
lines.zh: : 我那些饮料是上班发的,Chinami。而且我也会给你带,所以别把这事说得像我在财务上多么不负责任。

lines.en: : You know I could just buy you the whole company right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我可以直接买下那家公司对吧?

lines.en: : And inherit almost seventeen billion dollars of debt in the process? No thank you! Chinami just wants her account back.
lines.zh: : 然后顺便继承将近一百七十亿美元的债务?不必了,谢谢!Chinami 只想要回她的账号。

lines.en: : We can use Onee-sama’s. I just have to remember which one of her horses she named her password after.
lines.zh: : 我们可以用 Onee-sama 的。我只要想起来她的密码是用哪匹马命名的就行。

lines.en: : Anything else, Chinami? Something that doesn’t involve Netflix or food or signing some sort of contract that would require me taking out a loan for a zoo?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗,Chinami?一些不涉及网飞、不涉及食物、也不涉及「要我贷款养个动物园」的合同的事?

lines.en: : Yes. Chinami formally requests that you be careful walking to work and look both ways twice before crossing the street so she doesn’t need to buy a new picture frame with her zero dollars.
lines.zh: : 有。Chinami 正式请求你上班路上小心,过马路前朝两边各看两次,这样她就不必用她仅有的零元,去买一个新相框了。

lines.en: : Would it make you happy if I start giving you an allowance?
lines.zh: : 如果我开始给你零花钱,你会开心吗?

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss6
: Chinami loves you, big sis Chika! Have fun at work and make sure to bring her back some tea!
lines.zh: : Chinami 爱你,Chika 大姐!上班愉快,记得给她带奶茶!

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what I thought. Be good, okay? Watch one of your Disney movies. You remember how to work the VCR, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯,我就知道。乖乖的,好吗?看一部你的迪士尼电影。你还记得录像机怎么用,对吧?

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么玩意?

lines.en: : Mhm! Bye-bye! Love you!
lines.zh: : 嗯!拜拜!爱你!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss7
: Love you! And no touching the Niki wall! I don’t want any fingerprints on my GOD.
lines.zh: : 爱你!还有,不许碰 Niki 墙!我不想在我的「神」上留下指纹。

lines.en: : Didn’t she completely lay into you during your Dorm Wars thing? Chinami said she did. You still like her anyway?
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战那次,她不是把你骂得狗血淋头吗?Chinami 说她骂了。你还是喜欢她?

lines.en: : Of course! Niki was just trying to help me get my life back on track! Which is why I now owe her both my body and my mind. And people say to never meet your idols! HA!
lines.zh: : 当然!Niki 只是试图帮我把人生拉回正轨!所以我如今连身体带心智都欠她。人们还说「永远不要见偶像」呢!哈!

lines.en: : ANYWAY, BYE. DON’T TOUCH THE WALL.
lines.zh: : 总之,拜拜。不许碰那面墙。

lines.en: : It’s a step in the right direction. Big sis Chika will get there. Chinami is sure of it.
lines.zh: : 这是朝正确方向迈进的一步。Chika 大姐会到的。Chinami 确信。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss8
: Maybe that Niki lady needs to talk to my family too? My mom and Onee-sama have both been kind of weird lately.
lines.zh: : 也许那位 Niki 女士也该和我家人聊聊?我妈妈和 Onee-sama 最近都有点怪。

lines.en: : Really? They’re not Niki fans too, are they? Chinami thought Tsukasa’s family would be too civilized for that.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?她们不会也是 Niki 粉吧?Chinami 以为 Tsukasa 的家人会文明到不至于此。

lines.en: : We are. And, as far as I know, nobody in my family is any sort of “fan” at all.
lines.zh: : 我们是文明人。而且据我所知,我们家没有任何人是任何意义上的「粉丝」。

lines.en: : But Onee-sama changed her phone wallpaper to Jeeves and my mom kissed my ear the other day. So something is definitely going on.
lines.zh: : 但 Onee-sama 把手机壁纸换成了 Jeeves,而我妈妈前几天亲了我的耳朵。所以绝对有事在发生。

lines.en: : Does your mom not normally kiss you? Big sis Chika kisses Chinami on the forehead all the time.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈平时不亲你吗?Chika 大姐可是经常亲 Chinami 的额头。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that was the first time ever. It didn’t feel like how I thought it would.
lines.zh: : 我很确定那是第一次。和我想象中的感觉不一样。

lines.en: : Chinami is sad that Tsukasa doesn’t get attention. But also, Chinami doesn’t want to keep talking about Tsukasa’s family because she’s feeling all sympathied out lately.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很难过 Tsukasa 得不到关注。但 Chinami 也不想继续聊 Tsukasa 的家事,因为她最近的同情心已经用光了。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss9
: Great! Me too. Well, without the sympathy part. I don’t think I’ve acquired that trait yet. I just want to talk about normal stuff today too.
lines.zh: : 太好了!我也是。除了同情那部分。我觉得我还没获得那个技能。所以今天我也只想聊正常的东西。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss10

: Like Breaking Bad? Because big sis Chika says it isn’t as good as Better Call Saul, but Chinami disagrees wholeheartedly and believes that having a sole deuteragonist instead of splitting that role between multiple characters is more conducive to a cohesive viewing experience that ultimately amplifies the emotional attachment viewers have to the roster and ultimately the story as a whole!
lines.zh: : 比如《绝命毒师》?因为 Chika 大姐说它不如《风骚律师》,但 Chinami 全心全意不同意,并坚信:只设一个单一的副主角、而不是把它拆给多个角色,更有利于连贯的观剧体验,最终放大观众对角色阵容、乃至对整个故事的情感依附!

lines.en: : That’s boring too. I want to talk about sex again.
lines.zh: : 那个也好无聊。我想再聊性。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss11
: Oh.
: Of course you do.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : Well, duh! Your sister is actually teaching you about stuff now! I bet if I asked mine to do the same thing, she’d just slam the door in my face.
lines.zh: : 废话!你姐姐现在都开始给你上课了!我打赌,要是我让我姐来教,她只会当面摔门。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss12
: True...Chinami doesn’t think she should be sharing any of that info with Tsukasa, though.
lines.zh: : 对……Chinami 不觉得她该把这些信息分享给 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Why? I’m technically older than you. And infinitely smarter.
lines.zh: : 为什么?严格来说,我比你大。而且聪明无限倍。

lines.en: : Because she specifically said “Don’t share any of this with Tsukasa no matter how many times she asks you to. Which she is definitely going to do because she is Tsukasa and somebody needs to tell her no sometimes.”
lines.zh: : 因为她特意说过:「无论 Tsukasa 求你多少次,都别把这些分享给她。而她绝对会求——因为她就是 Tsukasa,而且总得有人偶尔对她说『不』。」

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss13
: Well, of course she would say that as she is but a lowly commoner who can’t so much as fathom the concept of a girl my age having a net worth higher than she will ever achieve!
lines.zh: : 她当然会说那种话——她不过是个低贱的平民,连「一个我这种年纪的女孩,净资产比她一辈子挣的还多」这种概念都无法想象!

lines.en: : Hey! You’re bringing Chinami’s net worth into this too, you know!
lines.zh: : 喂!你把 Chinami 的净资产也拖下水了!

lines.en: : I am! But there is a good reason for this, Chinami! For I have something you want and you have something I want! It seems only fair that we exchange these things, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我是拖了!但这有充分的理由,Chinami!因为我有你想要的东西,而你有我想要的东西!我们交换,这才公平,不是吗?

lines.en: : Wha- no! Maybe! I don’t know! Tsukasa’s shirt beckons Chinami’s trust, though!
lines.zh: : 什——不!也许!我不知道!但 Tsukasa 的衬衫在召唤 Chinami 的信任!

lines.en: : Go on. Name your price. Is it money? Real estate? Impart your wisdom unto me and I will hoist the contents of my overflowing coffers unto you! Then, you can have as many Netflix accounts as you want!
lines.zh: : 说吧。开个价。是钱?房产?把你的智慧传授给我,我会把我满溢的金库举起来奉送!然后,你想要多少个网飞账号就有多少!

lines.en: : Chinami really only needs the one.
lines.zh: : Chinami 其实只要一个。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss14
: Well, how much is that? Like...¥100,000 a month or something?
lines.zh: : 那得多少钱?比如……每月十万日元?

lines.en: : Yes.
scene tsunamikiss15
: Then it is settled! I will pay for your Netflix account and, in return, you will teach me everything your teacher teaches you about sex! And I won’t need to put Jeeves in danger at all!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了!我支付你的网飞账号,作为交换,你把你老师教你的关于性的一切教给我!这样我根本不用把 Jeeves 置于险境!

lines.en: : Danger? How would Tsukasa put Chinami’s papa in danger?
lines.zh: : 险境?Tsukasa 怎么会把 Chinami 的爸爸置于险境?

lines.en: : This isn’t something for you to worry about, Chinami! Now, tell me why westerners always laugh at the word “bukkake!”
lines.zh: : 这不是你该操心的事,Chinami!现在,告诉我为什么西方人总是听到「bukkake」就笑!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss16
: Uhh...Chinami doesn’t think her lessons have covered that yet...
lines.zh: : 呃……Chinami 觉得她的课程还没讲到那一节……

lines.en: : Well, what have they covered? Because my only experiences with sexual education involve really boring slide shows and also making your adoptive father hate me.
lines.zh: : 那都讲了什么?因为我的性教育经历,只有无聊透顶的幻灯片,还有「让你养父恨我」。

lines.en: : Well...big sis Chika has really only told Chinami about...what it is and...why people do it. Which is kind of stuff she knew already, but she doesn’t really get what else she wants to know, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Chika 大姐其实只跟 Chinami 讲过……那是什么、还有……人为什么要做。这些 Chinami 本来就知道,但她不太明白她还想知道什么,所以……

lines.en: : Well, why do they do it then? Because the logistics of sexual intercourse make enough sense to me. It’s understanding the feelings of everyone involved that confuses me.
lines.zh: : 那他们为什么要做?性交的运作逻辑我能理解。让我困惑的,是「所有相关者的感受」。

lines.en: : Chinami was confused about that too until she had a weird dream about a rabbit. But if it’s anything like big sis Chika and Papa, then...I think it’s just something people want to do when they really like each other.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也困惑过,直到她做了一个关于兔子的怪梦。但如果那和 Chika 大姐、爸爸之间差不多,那……我想,那只是人们非常喜欢彼此时,「想」做的事。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss17
: So it’s akin to a compulsion? That would explain why Jeeves took his teacher friend into my room and made her scream like I have never heard a person scream before.
lines.zh: : 所以它接近一种冲动?这就说得通了——为什么 Jeeves 会把他的老师朋友带进我的房间,让她发出我从未听过一个人发出过的尖叫。

lines.en: : Well, apart from your sister. Who I have heard screaming the same way on several occasions now. Perhaps even louder. Can one’s emotions truly amplify sensations to that extent, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯——除了你姐姐。她那种尖叫,我如今已经听过好几次了。说不定还更响。不过,情绪真能把感觉放大到那种程度吗?

lines.en: : Wh...Why do you have to be so close to Chinami while asking this?
lines.zh: : 你……为什么问这个的时候,要凑 Chinami 这么近?

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss18
: Because we like each other but we don’t want to have sex! And I’m trying to figure out why! What is it that causes the sort of attraction your sister and Jeeves have to one another?
lines.zh: : 因为我们互相喜欢,但不想做!而我正试图搞明白为什么!是什么造就了你姐姐和 Jeeves 彼此之间的那种吸引力?

lines.en: : Ch...Chinami doesn’t even really understand how two girls can have sex yet either! She just knows they do sometimes!
lines.zh: : Ch……Chinami 连两个女孩怎么「做」都还没搞懂!她只知道她们有时候会!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss19
: Wait, yeah. What the heck? Like, I already know about the gays. But maybe I don’t know as much about sexual logistics as I thought I did in that specific...segment of the sexual world?
lines.zh: : 等等,对。什么鬼?比如说,基佬的事我是知道的。但在「性爱世界的那个特定板块」,我懂的可能没有我以为的多?

lines.en: : Or even the reason two girls would be attracted to each other sexually in the first place when I was under the assumption that female arousal was just the desire to have a man put his penis inside of you.
lines.zh: : 甚至包括:两个女孩为什么会彼此产生性吸引——我一直以为,女性的冲动就是「想要一个男人把他的 penis 放进你体内」。

lines.en: : I...um...Well, Chinami thinks that maybe sometimes...people just...do?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……嗯,Chinami 觉得,也许有时候……人们就是……做了?

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss20
: Big sis Chika told Chinami that...she is attracted to both boys and girls. But she couldn’t really explain why. So there’s probably no real...logic to it and it’s...something that just happens...
lines.zh: : Chika 大姐告诉 Chinami……她对男孩和女孩都有吸引。但她说不清为什么。所以大概这没有什么真正的……逻辑,它就是……发生了……

lines.en: : How do you know then? Which one you’re attracted to, I mean. Because I don’t think I’ve ever really felt that way about anybody before.
lines.zh: : 那你怎么知道?我是说,你被哪种性别吸引。因为我觉得,我从来没有对任何人有过那种感觉。

lines.en: : Well...big sis Chika also mentioned that sometimes, people just...aren’t interested in anybody that way. I think she called it, like...asexual? Or was that pansexual? There were too many. Chinami forgot them all.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Chika 大姐还说过,有时候,人们就是……对任何人都没那种兴趣。我想她管那叫……无性恋?还是泛性恋?名词太多了。Chinami 全忘了。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss21
: Wait a second! You mean to tell me there’s a chance I might just never be attracted to anybody?! That’s not fair at all!
lines.zh: : 等一下!你是说,有可能我永远都不会被任何人吸引?!那太不公平了!

lines.en: : W-W-W-W-Why is that not fair?! P...People are born the way they’re born, Tsukasa! Chinami would rather be asexual or pansexual than permanently almost-sick!
lines.zh: : 为……为……为什么不公平?!人……人天生什么样就什么样,Tsukasa!Chinami 宁愿无性恋或泛性恋,也不愿「永远差一点病死」!

lines.en: : Well, yeah! That’s unfair too! But I always figured the gays were just choosing who they liked based on extenuating circumstances like not being able to attract the sex they actually want!
lines.zh: : 嗯,对!那也不公平!但我一直以为,基佬只是在特殊情况下——比如吸引不到自己真正想要的性别——才做的选择!

lines.en: : Chinami’s not surprised by this evaluation at all based on the fact that Tsukasa is rich and rich people are normally bad!
lines.zh: : 基于这个评价,Chinami 完全不意外——毕竟 Tsukasa 是有钱人,而有钱人通常很坏!

lines.en: : Since when?!
lines.zh: : 什么时候开始的?!

lines.en: : Always! Why do you think there are so few of you and so many of me?!
lines.zh: : 一直是!你以为为什么你们那么少、我们这么多?!

lines.en: : Hard work and perseverance!
lines.zh: : 辛勤工作和坚持不懈!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss22
: You really need to get out of the house more.
lines.zh: : 你真的需要多出门了。

lines.en: : Chinami, we need to kiss.
lines.zh: : Chinami,我们需要接吻。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss23
: WE NEED TO WHAT?!
lines.zh: : 我们需要干什么?!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss24
: Kiss me or you aren’t my friend! I need to figure out if I’m one of the gays!
lines.zh: : 亲我,不然你就不算我的朋友!我得弄清楚我是不是基佬!

lines.en: : Or we could just, you know, not do that!
lines.zh: : 或者我们可以,你知道的,不干这个!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss25
: Don’t you want to know too, though?! Because we’ve both never experienced anything like what your sister or Onee-sama or Jeeves’ teacher friend have! Maybe we’re both gays! Or something even worse!
lines.zh: : 可你难道不想知道吗?!我们俩都从来没体验过你姐姐、Onee-sama 或 Jeeves 的老师朋友体验过的那种东西!说不定我们都是基佬!或者更糟!

lines.en: : There’s nothing wrong with any sexuality, Tsukasa! And stop calling them “the gays!” It’s rude! Probably!
lines.zh: : 任何性取向都没有错,Tsukasa!还有别叫她们「基佬」了!很没礼貌!大概!

lines.en: : Come on! Just once! And if we don’t feel anything, we’ll know for sure that we’re regular!
lines.zh: : 拜托!就一次!要是我们什么感觉都没有,就能确定我们是「正常人」了!

lines.en: : Don’t call heterosexual people “regular” either!
lines.zh: : 也别把异性恋叫「正常人」!

lines.en: : I just mean from a statistic perspective! I’m sure there are plenty of good gays out there! And, for all we know, we could be two of them! Which is exactly why we need to kiss!
lines.zh: : 我只是从统计学的角度说的!我确信世上有大量优秀的基佬!而且,谁知道呢,我们说不定就是其中之二!这正是我们需要接吻的原因!

lines.en: : B-B-B-B-B-But what if we’re not! Then won’t it be gross?! Or...what if you have germs?! What if you kill Chinami?! How will you be able to live with yourself with my blood on your hands?!
lines.zh: : 可、可、可、可、可万一我们不是!那不就恶心了?!或者……你身上有病菌怎么办?!万一你把 Chinami 害死了?!你手上沾着我的血,你要怎么活下去?!

lines.en: : That’s a problem for another day!
lines.zh: : 那是另一天的问题!

lines.en: : Easy for you to say! You’re still alive!
lines.zh: : 你说得好轻松!你还活着呢!

lines.en: : Chinami, please! I don’t want to wait until I’m married to some random rich guy to find out who I like! My time is running out quicker than even yours is! You don’t want to die a kiss-virgin, do you?!
lines.zh: : Chinami,求你了!我不想等到嫁给某个随机的有钱人,才弄清我喜欢谁!我的时间比你耗得还快!你不想以「初吻处女」的身份死去,对吧?!

lines.en: : Well...no! But Chinami always thought her first kiss would be a lot more romantic than helping her friend find out if she’s a lesbian!
lines.zh: : 嗯……不想!但 Chinami 一直以为,她的初吻会比「帮好朋友验证她是不是蕾丝边」浪漫得多!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss26
: I’d do it for you.
lines.zh: : 换成你,我也会帮你做的。

lines.en: : You’re the only real friend I’ve ever had, Chinami. Which is the only reason I feel comfortable doing this with you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你是我这辈子唯一真正的朋友,Chinami。这也是为什么,只有和你做这件事,我才觉得安心。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss27
: I won’t get you sick. And if we hate it, which we very well might, we never even have to talk about it again. It’s just an experiment. People do things like this all the time. Maybe.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你生病的。而且要是我们讨厌它——我们八成会——我们甚至都不用再提。这只是一个实验。人们经常做这种事。大概。

lines.en: : Maybe?!
: I don’t know! I just know that everybody’s growing up faster than we are and that we’re the ones getting left out because of it!
lines.zh: : 我不知道!我只知道,所有人都比我们长大得快,而被落下的就是我们!

lines.en: : And maybe you’re fine with that, but I’m not! I don’t have the luxury of waiting! I need to grow up now or everything I know is going to get way scarier and way harder! So please-
lines.zh: : 也许你无所谓,但我不行!我没有「等待」的奢侈!我必须现在就长大,否则我知道的一切都会变得更可怕、更艰难!所以求你——

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss28
: GAAAAAAAH! FINE! BUT ONLY BECAUSE YOU’RE GOING TO GIVE ME ¥100,000 A MONTH UNTIL ONE OF US DIES! NOT BECAUSE I LIKE GIRLS OR ANYTHING!
lines.zh: : 嘎啊啊啊!行!但只是因为你要每月给我十万日元,直到我们中的一个死掉!可不是因为我喜欢女孩什么的!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss29

lines.zh: : Ch……

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss30
: Mmh...
scene tsunamikiss31
: Mh?!
: Ahh...ahn...
scene tsunamikiss32
: W-W-W-W-W-W-W-W-WHAT THE HECK IS THAT?! WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO DO TO ME, YOU FREAK?!
lines.zh: : 这、这、这、这、这、这、这、这到底是什么?!你这个怪胎想对我干什么?!

lines.en: : What? That’s how they always do it in porn.
lines.zh: : 什么?A 片里都是这么演的。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss33
: PORN?!
lines.zh: : A 片?!

lines.en: : Yes! Have you not been studying the reference material I send you? You need to use your tongue. Anything less than that is going to make your partner think you’re inexperienced and scare them off.
lines.zh: : 对!你没有在学习我发给你的参考资料吗?要用舌头。做不到的话,对方会以为你没经验,然后被吓跑。

lines.en: : WE ARE INEXPERIENCED! THAT’S THE WHOLE REASON I AGREED TO THIS IN THE FIRST PLACE!
lines.zh: : 我们就是没经验!这他妈是我当初答应它的全部原因!

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss34
: Well, hey! On the bright side! I didn’t hate it!
lines.zh: : 嗯,嘿!往好处想!我没有讨厌它!

lines.en: : Oh boy. Congratulations...
lines.zh: : 哦,天。恭喜……

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss35
: But I didn’t really love it either...so I’m not really sure what this means for me for going forward.
lines.zh: : 可我也没多喜欢……所以我不太确定,这对我的未来意味着什么。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...I don’t think it has to mean anything yet.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我觉得它现在还不必意味着什么。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss36
: But time is-
lines.zh: : 可时间——

lines.en: : Chinami knows you think time is running out. And Chinami understands more than anyone how scary that is. But...she thinks forcing yourself to grow up faster because you’re afraid of that isn’t the answer.
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道你觉得时间不够了。而 Chinami 比谁都明白那有多可怕。但……她觉得,因为害怕就强迫自己加速长大,不是答案。

lines.en: : Why? I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 为什么?我不懂。

lines.en: : Because you’ll miss out on everything else life has to offer.
lines.zh: : 因为你将错过人生提供的其他一切。

lines.en: : Which is what? Being neglected? Overlooked? Treated like a bargaining chip meant to somehow elevate my family’s status even further up when it already towers over everything?
lines.zh: : 哪些?被忽视?被无视?被当作一个筹码——用来把我家族本已凌驾一切的地位再往上抬一抬?

lines.en: : Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……

lines.en: : You think I’d be doing this if I was happy with how things are? No. I’m doing this because it’s something new. Something I’ve seen make other people happy. So why not me?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得,要是我对现状满意,我还会做这个吗?不会。我做这个,是因为它是一件新东西。一件我见过让别人幸福的东西。那为什么不能是我?……

lines.en: : Why can’t I?
lines.zh: : 为什么我不能?

lines.en: : Now, if we could just try that one more time but with you also using your tongue-
lines.zh: : 现在,如果我们能再试一次,这次你再加上舌头——

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss37
: Chinami is going to watch Breaking Bad now. Please send her the money you promised.
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在要看《绝命毒师》了。请把你答应的钱发给我。

lines.en: : Can we practice again later?
lines.zh: : 那我们晚点还能练习吗?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : Tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 明天呢?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: scene tsunamikiss38
: Fine. Then I guess I’ll just have to practice with Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 行。那我只好去和 Jeeves 练习了。

lines.en: : NOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
scene black
That wouldn’t be the last time the two of them kiss — just the last time for a while.
lines.zh: 那不会是她们俩最后一次接吻——只是这一阵子的最后一次。

lines.en: And while one of them was still unsure about what this meant, it confirmed something for the other.
lines.zh: 虽然其中一人还不确定这意味着什么,但它向另一人证实了一件事。

lines.en: The experiment worked somehow.
lines.zh: 这场实验,不知怎么地,成功了。

lines.en: Just not in the way that was intended.
lines.zh: 只是不是按原本计划的方式。
